data.title: 妮姆芙 · 阳光泳圈草莓分体泳衣的傲娇斜瞥
data.description: 盛夏泳池中，妮姆芙套在透明条纹泳圈里浮在水面，身着红白草莓图案荷叶边分体泳装，小嘴咬着冰棒，略带傲娇地斜瞥着呼唤她的人。
data.action: 坐在彩色充气泳圈中，一只手搭在泳圈上，另一只手拿着水果雪糕，鼓着腮帮偏过小脑袋
data.lighting: 烈日映照下的粼粼池水，水珠在白皙娇嫩的肌肤上泛着晶亮光点
data.camera: 近景微俯视角，捕捉娇嗔可爱的傲娇神韵
data.promptProse: Nymph floats lazily in the sparkling waters of an outdoor pool, nested inside a transparent candy-striped swim ring. She wears an adorable two-piece swimsuit patterned with ripe strawberries and white ruffled hems. Nibbling on a half-melted fruit popsicle with puffed cheeks and a faint blush, she casts an aloof, tsundere sidelong glance toward anyone trying to catch her attention.
data.animaCaption: Floating inside a candy-striped swim ring, Nymph munches on a popsicle and turns away with an adorable tsundere pout.
